svg.title: RuVector: a guided tour of search, memory and learning
svg.desc: 23 chapters explain embeddings, HNSW, the attached explorer, persistent memory, graphs, hybrid retrieval, feedback, SONA, local decisions, lifecycle, governance, deployment and npx ruvector. Illustrations are conceptual. A readable companion walkthrough is included in the repository.

g.text: A guided journey through vector intelligence

HNSW is a layered network of nearby vectors.

Higher search breadth usually costs more work. Measure on your data.
